name: Petroleossil
look: a massive mound of tar and sludge with angry red eyes, a tar column carrying a huge gaping fossil skull of an ancient tyrant, fossil bones and spines floating all over it
entry: Holding a King's Rock, Petroleodd swallows tar and sludge until it becomes a mountain of it, with the fossil skull of an ancient tyrant floating up through the middle. It roars through its jaws.
how: Evolve Petroleodd at level 45 while it holds a King's Rock (the King's Rock is used up).
